body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Four test files in plugins/adlc-pi/test/ (build-gate-flail.test.mjs, gate-tool.test.mjs, rails-checker.test.mjs, reactive-gate.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync and guard removals in 51 try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/build-gate-flail.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-bg-flail-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/gate-tool.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-gate-tool-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/rails-checker.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-rails-chk-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
4. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/reactive-gate.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-reactive-gate-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove plugins/adlc-pi/test/build-gate-flail.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-pi/test/gate-tool.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-pi/test/rails-checker.test.mjs, and plugins/adlc-pi/test/reactive-gate.test.mjs from the ALLOWLIST set.
6. Verification:
   - node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/build-gate-flail.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/gate-tool.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/rails-checker.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/reactive-gate.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 4 test files contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 4 test files.
- AC3 None of the 4 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 All tests in the 4 files pass cleanly under node --test.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(adlc-pi): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 51 try/finally blocks in gates and rails tests
